scripts.dev: node scripts/free-ports.mjs 3000 8080 && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "node scripts/dev-api-env.mjs local"
scripts.dev:neon: node scripts/free-ports.mjs 3000 8080 && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "node scripts/dev-api-env.mjs neon"
scripts.dev:supabase: node scripts/free-ports.mjs 3000 8080 && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "node scripts/dev-api-env.mjs supabase"
scripts.dev:s3: node scripts/free-ports.mjs 3000 8080 && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "node scripts/dev-s3.mjs"
scripts.dev:docker: node scripts/free-ports.mjs 3000 8080 && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "node scripts/dev-api-docker.mjs local"
scripts.ollama:gpu:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu.yml --profile ollama up -d
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --profile ollama --profile s3 --profile postgres up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --profile ollama --profile s3 --profile postgres down
scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && go -C apps/api build -o bin/api ./cmd/server
